author: Megaprojects
description:
Anduril, a California defence startup, aims to revolutionise cruise missile production with its Barracuda family. After the 2026 Iran war rapidly depleted American Tomahawk stockpiles, the Pentagon signed framework deals for thousands of these cheaper missiles. Built using automotive manufacturing principles at a new Ohio facility, Barracuda promises affordable firepower.
